summary: Phases 1-10 complete. Phase 9 (C19 docstring-coverage floor) triggered its own STOP condition (G-12's unrefined heuristic measured 89.40%, under the 90% floor) and was escalated rather than resolved unilaterally; the user authorized a precisely-specified, once-applied refinement crediting enclosing `/-!` section comments (a blind spot G-12's own design already anticipated), which measures 92.34% -- clears the floor, and lands within 0.5 points of research's original 92.8% figure. Both figures are reported in C19's output. Phase 10 (Init.lean/CheckInitImports linter root) closed COMPLETED, proceeding in parallel with Phase 9's escalation since it only depends on Phase 2 (already done): found and corrected two plan-parenthetical imprecisions by reading CSLib's actual source directly rather than trusting the plan's description (Init.lean has 1 extra CSLib-local import, not 2; the exceptions list needs 1 entry, not 2), both confirmed empirically. Baseline: 434 modules do not yet transitively import FormalSystem.Init (the ~430-file rewrite is an explicit, deferred follow-up).

Phase 3 progress: C16 design (nolints.json-aware blocking batch, initially-static dupNamespace count), the rebuild-cost investigation, the load-bearing verification cycle, and a correction re: the team lead's objection timing.
Phase 4 progress: G-15 assert_not_exists, the BLValidity.lean transitive-seam exclusion discovered via a real build failure, and the corrected Scope Hypothesis (3 exclusions, not 2).

Phase 5 progress: lakefile docstring rewrites, C9 widening, the scripts/*.sh Scope Hypothesis correction, and the live dupNamespace textual check (validation trail: naive version found 10/14, _root_. false positives found and fixed, final version 14/14 exact match).
Phase 6 progress: C14 widening, the three genuine stale-count fixes (a third beyond the plan's two), and the new 'covers' precision guard for a genuine subset-claim false positive.
Phase 7 progress: readme-lint Check 4's stamp-vs-commit-date comparison and the equivalent pre/post verification used in place of a nonexistent Phase 1 baseline.
Phase 8 progress: C17 dead-declaration scan (989 findings, one spot-checked) and C18 paragraph duplication (zero findings, synthetic-test-verified mechanism).

Phase 9 progress: the STOP-condition escalation, the user-authorized /-!-section-credit refinement (precisely specified, validated in both directions against over- and under-crediting), and the final wired C19 check.
Phase 10 progress: Init.lean and CheckInitImports, the two CSLib-source corrections, and the 434-module baseline.

continuation_path: Phase 11 (Acceptance gate) is next and final -- depends on Phases 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, all of which are now complete.
